title: Border and Drop
author: Xanthe Underhill
blurb: Ada Reyes, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, works cases no one wants attributed. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
